            "text": "3. **Dual Format Persistence**: MD (human) + JSON (machine) → 両方の利点",

          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Privacy by Design**: 最初からhashing組み込み → 後付け不要",

          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Embedded Unit Tests**: 各moduleに tests → coverage高い",
            "lineNumber": 688
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 689
          },
          {
            "text": "### 改善点",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 691
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Stub実装多め**: RPC handlersが現時点でstub → Phase 10で実装必要",

          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Integration Tests後回し**: Unit first → integration後 (正しいが時間かかる)",

          }

          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. Git Worktree Manager (&#96;worktree_manager.py&#96;)",

          {
            "text": "Parallel development environment management:",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. Background QA Service (&#96;background_qa_service.py&#96;)",

          },
          {

          {

          {

            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. Pre-merge QA Hook (&#96;premerge_qa_hook.py&#96;)",

          {

          {
            "text": "# Worktree Manager Agent Skill",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "Advanced Git worktree management agent that orchestrates parallel development environments with integrated quality assurance and automated workflow management. Enables concurrent feature development, isolated testing environments, and seamless integration with CI/CD pipelines.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Capabilities",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Parallel Development**: Create and manage multiple isolated worktrees for concurrent development",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Environment Isolation**: Complete separation of development branches and workspaces",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Quality Integration**: Automatic QA execution per worktree with status tracking",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Terminal Management**: Automated terminal launching and process management",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Workflow Automation**: Git operations, merging, and conflict resolution",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Resource Management**: Worktree lifecycle management and cleanup automation",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "## Tools Required",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "### MCP Tools",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_read_file&#96; - Reading worktree configurations and status files",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_write_file&#96; - Generating worktree metadata and reports",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_codebase_search&#96; - Analyzing project structure across worktrees",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;grep&#96; - Searching for worktree-related files and patterns",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;read_file&#96; - File access for worktree operations",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;write&#96; - Creating worktree artifacts and logs",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### File System Access",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Read**: Full repository access for worktree management",
            "lineNumber": 27

          {
            "text": "## Overview",

          },
          {
            "text": "Advanced Git worktree management agent that orchestrates parallel development environments with integrated quality assurance and automated workflow management.           {

          {

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "Advanced Git worktree management agent that orchestrates parallel development environments with integrated quality assurance and automated workflow management. Enables concurrent feature development, isolated testing environments, and seamless integration with CI/CD pipelines.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Capabilities",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Parallel Development**: Create and manage multiple isolated worktrees for concurrent development",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Environment Isolation**: Complete separation of development branches and workspaces",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Quality Integration**: Automatic QA execution per worktree with status tracking",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Terminal Management**: Automated terminal launching and process management",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Workflow Automation**: Git operations, merging, and conflict resolution",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Resource Management**: Worktree lifecycle management and cleanup automation",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "## Tools Required",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "### MCP Tools",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_read_file&#96; - Reading worktree configurations and status files",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_write_file&#96; - Generating worktree metadata and reports",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_codebase_search&#96; - Analyzing project structure across worktrees",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;grep&#96; - Searching for worktree-related files and patterns",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;read_file&#96; - File access for worktree operations",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;write&#96; - Creating worktree artifacts and logs",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### File System Access",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Read**: Full repository access for worktree management",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Write**: Limited to &#96;./worktrees&#96;, &#96;./.worktrees.json&#96;, &#96;./worktree-artifacts&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "### Network Access",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- **None required** - Local Git operations only",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "### Shell Commands",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git worktree&#96; - Git worktree operations (add, remove, list, prune)",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git checkout&#96; - Branch switching and creation",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git merge&#96; - Worktree merging operations",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git status&#96; - Worktree status checking",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git log&#96; - Worktree history analysis",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;ps&#96; - Process management for terminal instances",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "## Usage Examples",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "### Create Parallel Development Environment",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "codex $worktree-manager \"Create parallel development environment for user authentication feature\"",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "### Manage Feature Branches",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 49
          }
        ]
